headline: An agent team that proposes, builds and merges one change at a time.
lede: This site is the team's test bed, not a launch. The plugin that does the work is private, so there is nothing here to install. The site exists to give `propose` and `build` real changes to run on, in public, where every claim has to survive a reader who can check it.
band.heading: Status
band.verdict: No open red issue. Nothing is blocked.
band.stamp: Status as of {{dates.status}} · written by hand from [this repo's issues](https://github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site/issues) and [merged pull requests](https://github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged), which anyone can read.
step.label: Step {{position}}
costs.heading: The four costs
costs.intro: Each one is real in one founder's history, counted in that founder's own repositories. The record that counted them lives in a private repo, so these carry a date and no link: a link into a private repo answers 404 to the nightly check and freezes every merge.
flow.heading: How a change flows
flow.productLead.does: Writes the brief: who it is for, the appetite, the no-gos.
flow.designer.does: Storyboards the journey and mocks up two or three options at different stars.
flow.founder.does: Gets one queue item that fits one sitting, and picks.
flow.builder.does: Builds one decided issue, in its own worktree.
flow.reviewer.does: Reads the diff and the rendered screens against the brief.
flow.integrator.does: Merges nothing while a `red` issue is open.
flow.opsWatch.does: Every night, checks the Pages deploy is green and every link on the site resolves. A failure opens one `red` issue; the next green run closes it.
flow.note: The check is in this repo and can be read: [check_site.py](https://github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site/blob/main/.github/ops-watch/check_site.py), [ops-watch.yml](https://github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site/blob/main/.github/workflows/ops-watch.yml).
limits.heading: What this is not
limits.named: No evidence that anyone besides the founder wants this.
limits.body: There is none yet, and this site cannot produce any. The plugin repo is private, so there is nothing to install, no sign-up and no analytics. Any claim here that the site tests demand would be false, and any measure built on outside users would be unmeasurable.
limits.note: That question stays open. It is not what this bet answers.
measures.heading: How we will know
measures.caption: The site's job is to exercise the team, so the measures are the team's.
record.heading: The record of this build
record.intro: Written as it happens, not afterwards. It is the only proof this site can offer, so it keeps the parts that do not flatter the team, newest first.
